parameters.min: The least value the thumb reaches (0 by default).
parameters.max: Highest volume the thumb can reach.
parameters.divisions: Number of equal intervals on the track.
parameters.format: How each figure prints ((v) => '${(v * 100).round()}%'), on the line and to a screen reader. Figures and symbols only.
parameters.unit: The word after the figure ("pages", "min"), announced with every value.
parameters.label: Names the volume control.
